notice: Observational prompts and limitations, not a defect detector or safety certification.

site.visible_observation_examples: Ground slopes, visible ponding/staining, paths and retaining walls
site.not_established_from_photographs: Grading performance during storms, underground drainage, soil stability
site.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Document slopes and water patterns visually; recommend drainage review where warranted

foundation.visible_observation_examples: Visible foundation faces, cracks, penetrations and moisture marks
foundation.not_established_from_photographs: Footings below grade, load-bearing adequacy, concealed foundation conditions
foundation.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Identify visible type/material only when exposed; structural interpretation needs specialist

subfloor.visible_observation_examples: Exposed floor platform and underside, visible moisture or damaged surfaces
subfloor.not_established_from_photographs: Concealed subfloor layers, fastening and load capacity
subfloor.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Record material only from an unobstructed view; floor finish is not proof of subfloor composition

framing.visible_observation_examples: Exposed studs, joists, beams, roof members and obvious modifications
framing.not_established_from_photographs: Concealed framing, load paths and structural adequacy
framing.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Describe visible framing only; unknown members remain unknown

exterior.visible_observation_examples: Visible cladding, trim, door/window flashings and attached assemblies
exterior.not_established_from_photographs: Concealed WRB, attachment and cavity moisture
exterior.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Photograph seams/openings with wide context and close detail

roof.visible_observation_examples: Roof covering, penetrations, flashing, drainage and visible surface irregularities
roof.not_established_from_photographs: Remaining roof life, inaccessible roof deck and hidden leaks
roof.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Record access method and visibility; a photo cannot certify leak-free performance

attic.visible_observation_examples: Roof framing, visible insulation, stains, vent openings and obstructions
attic.not_established_from_photographs: R-values absent measurement, hidden condensation, structural adequacy
attic.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Do not infer whole-attic condition from one access view

interior.visible_observation_examples: Visible walls, floors, stairs, windows, doors and installed alarm devices
interior.not_established_from_photographs: Concealed wiring/plumbing, structural condition and alarm function unless tested
interior.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Separate observed condition from operation or diagnostic claims

electrical.visible_observation_examples: Accessible labeled panel exterior, service entry and observed devices
electrical.not_established_from_photographs: Live voltage, current safety, grounding continuity and concealed conductor types
electrical.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: No invasive or energized testing instruction from the model; qualified electrical specialist referral

plumbing.visible_observation_examples: Visible exposed piping, traps, fixtures and moisture evidence
plumbing.not_established_from_photographs: Concealed supply/drain runs, water quality and hidden leakage
plumbing.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Material identification needs exposed segment; use evidence of actual tests for operation

water_heating.visible_observation_examples: Heater type, visible piping/venting, rating plate make/model/serial
water_heating.not_established_from_photographs: Manufacture date absent clear plate, installation date, burner/combustion safety
water_heating.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Use exact brand-specific date source and disclose cycle ambiguity; no warranty assumptions

hvac.visible_observation_examples: Equipment identifiers, visible ducts, flues, condensate piping and exterior units
hvac.not_established_from_photographs: Heating/cooling performance absent field testing, heat exchanger integrity and refrigerant data
hvac.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Separate manufacture age, installation date, service history and measured operation

crawlspace.visible_observation_examples: Access conditions, exposed supports, moisture and vapor-barrier presence
crawlspace.not_established_from_photographs: Hidden soil conditions, concealed framing, radon concentration and foundation performance
crawlspace.safe_capture_and_review_guidance: Access limitation mandatory; radon and environmental risks require dedicated tests
